title: Privacy Policy
shortSummary: <bold>TL;DR:</bold> We only keep what the site needs to work. You sign up through your DeviantArt account, so there is no password to make up. An e-mail address, a password, two-step verification and passkeys are all optional extras you can add to your account; e-mail addresses are stored encrypted, passwords only as a one-way hash, and nothing is shared with or sold to 3rd parties.

intro.p1: The MLP Vector Club ("us", "we", or "our") operates <link>{host}</link> (the "Site"). This page informs you of our policies regarding the collection, use and disclosure of Personal Information we receive from users of the Site.
intro.p2: We use your Personal Information only for providing and improving the Site. By using the Site, you agree to the collection and use of information in accordance with this policy.

infoCollectionAndUse.heading: Information Collection And Use
infoCollectionAndUse.p1: While using our Site we do not ask you for more Personally Identifiable Information ("PII", "Personal Information") than the features you choose to use need. PII may include, but is not limited to: your name, birth date, national identification numbers, e-mail address, location, phone number. What we store for your account is described in the Accounts section below.
infoCollectionAndUse.p2: When performing certain actions on our Site (including, but not limited to the creation and deletion of Requests and Reservations, adding, modifying and deletion of Personal Color Guide Appearances) we store the IP address associated with the user and the action being performed in an Application Log.
infoCollectionAndUse.p3: Entries in the Application Log are stored permanently, but IP addresses are removed from the entries after 3 months. Additionally, any Personal Information that might have inadvertently been recorded can be wiped on request.
infoCollectionAndUse.p4: We allow the submission of user-generated material (text and images) on our Site. When posting content you should avoid posting any Personal Information because most submitted content is made publicly available immediately. For certain actions you have the ability to remove things you post, removing it from public view immediately. Some information may still be retained in our Application Log, so please contact us using the method(s) described at the end of this document to notify us if our intervention is needed.
infoCollectionAndUse.p5: Do note that we cannot guarantee that information removed from our website that was previously publicly accessible would cease to exist online as any number of services outside our control may choose to make copies of content found on this site. This includes search engines such as Google.
infoCollectionAndUse.p6: Accounts are created through DeviantArt's OAuth 2 API ("API"), which is secured using HTTPS. During the OAuth authentication process our Site does not receive your DeviantArt password, we only receive tokens that identify you to the API. We store the basic information provided by the API (user ID, current and some previous usernames, avatar link) and the tokens themselves, which we use to check that you still allow us to recognize you through DeviantArt.
infoCollectionAndUse.p7: This information is not removed from our database automatically if you deactivate your DeviantArt account, so be sure to reach out to us if you would like your data removed. Please note that if you have any interactions on the site removing all of your data completely may not be possible.

accounts.heading: Accounts
accounts.p1: You can add the following to your account. All of it is optional, and you can sign in with DeviantArt without any of it.
accounts.email: <bold>E-mail address:</bold> if you give us one, we store it encrypted. To find an account by address we also store a keyed hash of it, from which the address cannot be read back. We use it only to send you messages about your account (verifying the address, resetting a forgotten password) and never for newsletters or advertising, and we do not share it with anyone.
accounts.emailVerification: When you add or change an address, we keep the address and a one-time verification code for 24 hours (this copy is not encrypted) so that we can send you the confirmation link, then delete them. If you use the "block" link in a message that you did not expect, the address is added to a do-not-send list so that the site never mails it again.
accounts.password: <bold>Password:</bold> we never store your password itself, only a salted bcrypt hash that cannot be turned back into the password. Changing or resetting your password signs you out everywhere.
accounts.reset: A password reset link is valid for 60 minutes and only one is active per account. Of the link's secret we only keep a hash, and it is deleted once used.
accounts.twoFactor: <bold>Two-step verification:</bold> the secret of your authenticator app is stored encrypted, and your recovery codes are stored only as hashes.
accounts.passkeys: <bold>Passkeys:</bold> we store the public part of each passkey you register, the name you gave it and when it was last used. The private key and any fingerprint or face data never leave your device.
accounts.discord: <bold>Linked Discord account:</bold> if you link one, we store your Discord username, display name, avatar, whether you are a member of the club's Discord server, and the tokens Discord gave us to refresh that information. You can unlink it from your account page, which removes these.
accounts.sessions: <bold>Sessions:</bold> each browser you sign in with has a session record containing the IP address and browser (user agent) it was started from and the time of its last activity. You can see your sessions on your account page and end any of them. Sessions of visitors who are not signed in only hold a security token and are deleted after a day without activity.

logData.heading: Log Data
logData.p1: We collect information that your browser sends whenever you visit our Site ("Log Data"). This Log Data may include information such as your computer's IP address, operating system, browser type, browser version, the pages of our Site that you visit, the time and date of your visit and other statistics.
logData.p2: This Log Data is stored only within our server and is not shared with any third party. Log Data is used for diagnostic purposes, and shared with law enforcement agencies if explicitly requested. It is kept for up to 14 days and discarded afterwards.

cookies.heading: Cookies
cookies.p1: Cookies are files with small amount of data. Cookies are sent to your browser from a web site and stored on your computer's hard drive.
cookies.p2: We use "cookies" to retain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some portions of our Site.
cookies.p3: For every visitor we store a randomly generated token ("CSRF Token") used to prevent Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) attacks and thus improve the site's security. It is not tied to any specific person until you sign in, and for visitors who are not signed in the session it belongs to is deleted after a day without activity. This cookie is required for most actions on the site that alter stored information, and as such disabling cookies will remove your ability to change or modify site content.
cookies.p4: When you sign in, a session cookie keeps you signed in. If you choose to be remembered, the cookie also keeps you signed in across browser sessions. If you want to stop being remembered you can sign out, end the session from your account page, or clear the cookies set by our Site.
cookies.p5: If you choose a color theme (light or dark) in the sidebar, the choice is kept for 1 year in a cookie so the page can be shown in that theme right away. It contains only the word "light" or "dark". Without a choice no such cookie is set and the page follows your device's setting.

security.heading: Security
security.p1: The security of your Personal Information is important to us, but remember that no method of transmission over the Internet, or method of electronic storage, is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your Personal Information, we cannot guarantee its absolute security.
security.p2: The Site makes use of HTTPS using modern TLS encryption suites to protect the integrity and secure transport of data between the browser and our Site. However, we make use of CloudFlare's Reverse Proxy service, meaning all data sent to our Site passes through their servers. CloudFlare operates under their own <link>privacy policy</link>.
security.p3: When you use a compatible browser you will be connected to a Web Socket Server in order to receive updates to content on the page, including live notifications for signed in users. This feature cannot be turned off separately. Any PII this server receives (which is limited to your IP address) is discarded as soon as the connection is closed, typically by closing the browser window. The data exchange between the Web Socket Server and the Site is done locally and no PII is transmitted between the two parts of the application.
security.p4: In the event of a security breach all users will be notified within 24 hours of discovery through a notice posted on this website as well as a journal on DeviantArt.

changes.heading: Changes To This Privacy Policy
changes.p1: This Privacy Policy is effective as of October 22, 2026 and will remain in effect except with respect to any changes in its provisions in the future, which will be in effect immediately after being posted on this page.
changes.p2: We reserve the right to update or change our Privacy Policy at any time and you should check this Privacy Policy periodically. Your continued use of the Service after we post any modifications to the Privacy Policy on this page will constitute your acknowledgment of the modifications and your consent to abide and be bound by the modified Privacy Policy.
changes.p3: If we make any material changes to this Privacy Policy, we will notify you by placing a prominent notice on our website.

contact.heading: Contact Us
contact.p1: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy or want to ask for the removal of any PII we store (including your account, e-mail address or linked accounts) please contact us using any of the methods accessible from the <link>Contact</link> link in the footer.
